purpose: TRAIN structure diversity and post-feedback sensing supervision; not a new B2-necessity gate
not_authorized_by_this_file: automatic root replacement by label outcome

admission.selection_order: family order below then ascending candidate seed; globally deduplicate conservative structural hashes before solving
exclude: all V1 structural hashes and roots
already reserved public DEV/test/OOD registry hashes
structural_checks: all probes reachable and returnable at capacity 5
max channel multiplicity one per protocol
at least two sequential singleton measurement batches plus one task feasible at H=12 and capacity 5 for some channel order; no optimality check
admission.on_exhaustion: retain missing stratum and rejection log; no silent redesign
admission.on_unresolved: retain root and selected state; no retry or replacement

randomness.derivation: SHA256 canonical JSON [namespace,root_seed,stream_name]; random.Random seeded by resulting integer
randomness.paired_variants: public likelihood/prior/topology fixed within root; cross horizons 9/12 with capacities 3/5; never count variants as independent roots
randomness.categorical_defaults: uniform choice from each explicitly listed set; independent Bernoulli graph edges; prior integer weights independently uniform in 2..5, normalized exactly; uniform hypothesis permutation and channel polarity bits

families.sensors: coarse c0 plus complementary specialized cL/cR; outside subtree probability 1/2
families.graph: three measurement nodes; directed transit Bernoulli p=1/2; independent direct/shared-cleanup return choices; singleton sensing durations total 3

families.sensors: same coarse/specialized semantics plus zero or one weak duplicate
families.graph: directed connectivity p in {1/4,1/2,3/4}; single shared-preparation hub and random shared-cleanup incidences
independent directed transit and return choices; not a reskin of an admitted graph

families.sensors: coarse/specialized plus one or two sensors: duplicate specialization, weak broad-group or strong high-cost broad-group
families.graph: directed transit p=1/2 with return-structure randomization

return_structure.shared_cleanup: measurement node -> cleanup_node -> reset; first duration=1, second duration=cleanup, each energy=1; genuine extra recovery time/energy
return_structure.random_choice: each measurement independently direct or shared_cleanup with probability 1/2; create one shared cleanup node only if used
return_structure.nontriviality: do not add unreachable padding nodes or zero-cost subdivisions solely to inflate structure count

base_operation_graph.prepare: reset -> ready: configured prepare duration, energy 1, no observation
base_operation_graph.probe: ready -> channel node: per-channel configured probe duration, energy 1, that channel observed
base_operation_graph.transit_probe: channel i -> channel j: configured transit + probe_j duration, energy 2, observe j; one edge per independently admitted ordered pair
base_operation_graph.task: one reset self-loop per hypothesis, unit utility only at matching hypothesis, duration=energy=1; task payoff is not feedback
base_operation_graph.empty_return: ready -> reset: cleanup duration, energy 1, zero utility
base_operation_graph.extra_sensors: random_resource: uniform 0/1 duplicate specialized sensor with quality 3/5; decoy: uniform 1/2 extra sensors, each uniformly duplicate-specialized, weak-coarse or strong-coarse; strong-coarse probe duration 2
base_operation_graph.cost_draws: listed prepare/cleanup/transit choices drawn once per root; probe choices independently per channel, then fixed across all H/B variants

state_collection.explorer: among bounded legal measuring candidates, maximize sum_y P_b(y|p)*sum_h (b_y[h]-b[h])^2 / duration(p); zero utility in ranking; lexical tie break
state_collection.explorer_role: training-state coverage only, not a performance baseline or novelty claim
state_collection.candidate_builder: bounded prefix beam width 16; no full catalogue required by explorer
state_collection.retention: union source pools, deduplicate sufficient states retaining provenance; deterministic round-robin over occupied public-feature strata, hash priority within each stratum

strata.boundary_rule: left closed/right open, last bin includes 1; all arithmetic rational
strata.duplicate_history_rule: if one sufficient state appears in several strata via different histories, assign its lexicographically smallest stratum once; preserve all provenance

work_limits.accounting: separate candidate/admission, collection, label solve, export/audit CPU, wall and counters; complete state/root checkpoints; interrupted work logged separately

student_split.unit: connected component of shared root or structural-clone identities; all paired cost/horizon/capacity variants stay together
student_split.rule: salted hash order on all admitted groups before labels; first floor(N/4) validation; remainder train
student_split.scope: internal TRAIN corpus holdout, not public DEV or confirmation

reporting_targets_not_admission_filters.if_not_met: report shortfall; do not label-filter roots, alter holdout or launch formal AFPP training
reporting_targets_not_admission_filters.sizing_pilot: solve only first two admitted structures per family with all four H/capacity variants; report cost/yield including unresolved; no automatic full-corpus launch

training_future.default_sampling: uniform state then prefix with unit total state weight
training_future.rare_class_balancing: possible later versioned TRAIN-only choice; not used in this design pilot
